raw_snippet: Since launching Handshake’s AI unit, Lord says it has grown from zero to more than $1 billion in gross annualized revenue in 16 months
dispute_text: An annualised month reported by the press or the company, not booked or audited revenue, and often sourced to the company itself.
note: Handshake's AI unit launched in January 2025; sixteen months puts the reading at about May 2026. A lower bound (more than).
